title: Revenge of Shinobi, The
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; ninja magic; shuriken
Ninja action starring a Shinobi warrior (a 2002 GBA game, not a port of the 1989 Mega Drive one)
Your life bar refills from health pickups; shuriken and ninja magic are limited

Sword slashes, shuriken, ninja magic
Sword for close range; shuriken for enemies across gaps
Ninja magic clears the screen or protects you: save it for bosses
The ending you get depends on how you play (the ROM has separate good and bad endings)

Stage-end bosses
Bosses telegraph their attacks: back off during the wind-up, strike after
The final enemy is Ashira; reaching him with full magic makes the fight easier
Use shuriken to hit bosses from safe distance when they hover or jump

Stages across Japan
Stages are reached in order; passwords save your progress between sessions
Each stage ends with a boss gate

Shuriken ammo, magic, health
Shuriken refills and magic pickups appear in breakable objects and from enemies
Health pickups heal part of the life bar

Hidden items
The password screen lets you continue from a later stage
Hidden pickups are often above the main path: jump on ledges

Stages cleared
Passwords record your stage; write them down at each stage start
Beat Ashira to finish the story
